claims.claim: EXECUTION FAILURE preserves absent, null and strict-integer native exit status through projection, re-projection and canonical readers without changing private original bytes.
Private, public and legacy boundaries reject native error.exit_code outside EXECUTION while preserving independent verification command exit_code outcomes.

Synthetic fixtures cover invalid native types, forged phases, nested private fields, unsafe origins, duplicate keys, tampered digests and wrong subjects across readers, projectors and source reconciliation without exposing captured output.

Synthetic real-Git roundtrips retain exact RUN/TASK/failed-head/candidate identity and FAILURE status. Lawful small, V1 and V2 command outcomes remain readable; incomplete observation processing remains unchanged when native error.exit_code is absent.

Existing diagnostic categories, capture redaction, quoted selectors and source binding remain intact. Local Executor fixtures preserve exact-admission reads and reject forged locators, subjects, digests and admissions.

Committed changes affect only the four permitted files and update existing validation paths without adding authority, a transport pipeline, historical candidate replay, policy changes, terminal mutation or publication.
